text:
maria: Quick q — before we onboard reranker-v2 (float->ptq) can we lock down benchmark split/holdout guidelines? want to avoid NDCG/MRR gotchas after quant.
amit: +1. main failure modes: dataset shift, tokenizer mismatch, candidate ordering.
jon: For holdout I prefer stratified time-based split (last 10%) + a static 'golden' calibration set. ensures real drift catch and stable gate.
lina: Also need to standardize doc formatting: strip HTML, normalize whitespace, and canonicalize urls. tiny differences change tokenization.
maria: Agreed. proposal: 80/10/10 train/val/holdout by time, plus a 1k 'calibration' golden set sampled across query lengths and answerability.
amit: For PTQ experiments add a synthetic-negatives sweep. quant can change relative distances; we should monitor per-query top1 flips and tail NDCG.
jon: Add metrics: ndcg@1, ndcg@5, ndcg@10, mrr, top1_flip_rate, per-length-slice ndcg. Calculate bootstrap CI.
lina: Important: candidate ordering must be randomized before scoring in offline harness. document-order artifacts cause fake gains.
eval-bot: baseline: reranker-v1 (float) ndcg@10=0.342, mrr=0.276 (seed 42)
maria: Nice. For reproducibility: fix tokenizer version, vocab, and seed across all steps. record model commit and quant config in eval metadata.
amit: Also capture token length distributions. PTQ can choke on long tails.
jon: Quick eval command we can standardize:
```bash
eval-harness --model /models/reranker-v2 \n  --split data/holdout.jsonl \n  --metrics ndcg@1 ndcg@5 ndcg@10 mrr top1_flip_rate \n  --seed 42 \n  --tokenizer v2-tokenizer.json \n  --output out/rerank-v2-holdout.json
```
lina: And a minimal config snippet for the holdout sampling:
```json
{"holdout_pct":10, "stratify_by":["query_len_bucket","answerable"], "seed":42}
```
maria: For gating: block merges if ndcg@10 drops > 0.8% absolute on the golden calibration set OR if top1_flip_rate > 3%.
amit: That seems strict but reasonable for ptq. we can relax for small models; param in PR.
jon: I'll add CI job to run float vs ptq diff on calibration set and fail if thresholds exceeded.
lina: Who owns creation of the calibration set? is that ops or eng-ml?
maria: I'll curate initial 1k and put under data/gold/calibration_v1.jsonl. owner: eng-ml for now.
eval-bot: ci job scheduled: rerank-holdout-check (weekly).
maria: Action items: @jon add CI job, @amit add synthetic neg sweep scripts, @lina add formatting canonicalizer + PR to preproc, I'll publish the holdout/golden artifact.
jon: ack, starting today.
amit: will spin up ptq smoke runs once CI is in place.
lina: will push canonicalizer PR by EOD.
maria: Thanks all :rocket:
